title: Sangat that teaches the life what to become
subtitle: For the day that needs better company to keep its purpose
description: These readings show how atmosphere, placement, and shared remembrance help the rare human chance become a lived answer.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The chance of human birth is protected by Naam and sangat, where direction is reinforced in company.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Choose support that turns you toward meeting the Lord, not merely away from discomfort.

evidence.coreClaim: This journey treats sangat as formation, not social comfort alone.
evidence.turn: Company changes what the heart can become by changing what it repeatedly remembers.
evidence.practicalImplication: Place yourself today where remembrance is easier and waste is harder.
